Granted. Used to notice the screen turning on, list notifications and show media controls.
Not granted. The wake screen needs it to appear.
Allowed. The wake screen can appear when the screen turns on.
Not allowed. On Android 10 and later this lets the wake screen appear when the screen turns on. Nothing is drawn over other apps.
Shown. Private notifications are listed in full on a locked phone (unless Android\'s own lock-screen setting hides them).
Hidden. Private notifications show only the app name until you unlock.
Unlocked. One purchase unlocks every TrekUI app.
Free trial. One purchase unlocks every TrekUI app. The wake screen never stops you unlocking your phone.
TrekUI Lock Screen is a look, not a lock: unlocking always goes through Android\'s own PIN, pattern, password or biometric check. Nothing it reads leaves your device.
